잠언-11-1.title: 잠언 11장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-1.exegesis: 32. know-- regard and provide for ( Psa 1:6 ). frowardness-- all kinds of deceit and ill-nature. The word is plural.
잠언-11-1.theologicalNote: 32. know-- regard and provide for ( Psa 1:6 ). frowardness-- all kinds of deceit and ill-nature. The word is plural.

잠언-11-2.title: 잠언 11장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 11 Pr 11:1-31 . 1. (Compare Margin). The Hebrews used stones for weights. just-- complete in measure.
잠언-11-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 11 Pr 11:1-31 . 1. (Compare Margin). The Hebrews used stones for weights. just-- complete in measure.

잠언-11-3.title: 잠언 11장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-3.exegesis: 2. Self-conceit is unteachable; the humble grow wise (compare Pr 16:18 ; 18:12 ).
잠언-11-3.theologicalNote: 2. Self-conceit is unteachable; the humble grow wise (compare Pr 16:18 ; 18:12 ).

잠언-11-4.title: 잠언 11장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-4.exegesis: 3. guide-- to lead, as a shepherd ( Pr 6:7 ; Psa 78:52 ). perverseness-- ill-nature. destroy-- with violence.
잠언-11-4.theologicalNote: 3. guide-- to lead, as a shepherd ( Pr 6:7 ; Psa 78:52 ). perverseness-- ill-nature. destroy-- with violence.

잠언-11-5.title: 잠언 11장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-5.exegesis: 4. (Compare Pr 10:2 ). wrath-- that is, of God.
잠언-11-5.theologicalNote: 4. (Compare Pr 10:2 ). wrath-- that is, of God.

잠언-11-6.title: 잠언 11장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-6.exegesis: 5. direct-- or, "make plain"; wicked ways are not plain ( Pr 13:17 ).
잠언-11-6.theologicalNote: 5. direct-- or, "make plain"; wicked ways are not plain ( Pr 13:17 ).

잠언-11-7.title: 잠언 11장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-7.exegesis: 6. deliver them-- that is, from evil, which the wicked suffer by their own doings ( Pr 5:22 ; Psa 9:16 ).
잠언-11-7.theologicalNote: 6. deliver them-- that is, from evil, which the wicked suffer by their own doings ( Pr 5:22 ; Psa 9:16 ).

잠언-11-8.title: 잠언 11장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-8.exegesis: 7. expectation ... perish-- for death cuts short all his plans ( Lu 16:25 ). hope of unjust-- better, "hope of wealth," or "power" (compare Is 40:29 , Hebrew). This gives an advance on the sentiment of the first clause. Even hopes of gain die with him.
잠언-11-8.theologicalNote: 7. expectation ... perish-- for death cuts short all his plans ( Lu 16:25 ). hope of unjust-- better, "hope of wealth," or "power" (compare Is 40:29 , Hebrew). This gives an advance on the sentiment of the first clause. Even hopes of gain die with him.

잠언-11-9.title: 잠언 11장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-9.exegesis: 8. Perhaps the trouble prepared by the wicked, and which he inherits (compare Pr 11:6 ).
잠언-11-9.theologicalNote: 8. Perhaps the trouble prepared by the wicked, and which he inherits (compare Pr 11:6 ).

잠언-11-10.title: 잠언 11장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-10.exegesis: 9. (Compare Psa 35:16 ; Da 11:32 ). The just is saved by superior discernment.
잠언-11-10.theologicalNote: 9. (Compare Psa 35:16 ; Da 11:32 ). The just is saved by superior discernment.

잠언-11-11.title: 잠언 11장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-11.exegesis: 10-11. The last may be a reason for the first. Together, they set forth the relative moral worth of good and bad men.
잠언-11-11.theologicalNote: 10-11. The last may be a reason for the first. Together, they set forth the relative moral worth of good and bad men.

잠언-11-12.title: 잠언 11장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-12.exegesis: 10-11. The last may be a reason for the first. Together, they set forth the relative moral worth of good and bad men.
잠언-11-12.theologicalNote: 10-11. The last may be a reason for the first. Together, they set forth the relative moral worth of good and bad men.

잠언-11-13.title: 잠언 11장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-13.exegesis: 12. despiseth-- or, "reviles," a course contrasted with the prudent silence of the wise. holdeth his peace-- as if neither hearing nor telling.
잠언-11-13.theologicalNote: 12. despiseth-- or, "reviles," a course contrasted with the prudent silence of the wise. holdeth his peace-- as if neither hearing nor telling.

잠언-11-14.title: 잠언 11장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-14.exegesis: 13. tale-bearer-- (Compare Margin), one trading as a peddler in scandal, whose propensity to talk leads him to betray confidence.
잠언-11-14.theologicalNote: 13. tale-bearer-- (Compare Margin), one trading as a peddler in scandal, whose propensity to talk leads him to betray confidence.

잠언-11-15.title: 잠언 11장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-15.exegesis: 14. counsel-- the art of governing ( Pr 1:5 ). counsellors-- literally, "one giving counsel"; the participle used as a collective.
잠언-11-15.theologicalNote: 14. counsel-- the art of governing ( Pr 1:5 ). counsellors-- literally, "one giving counsel"; the participle used as a collective.

잠언-11-16.title: 잠언 11장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-16.exegesis: 15. (Compare Pr 6:1 ). suretiship-- (Compare Margin), the actors put for the action, which may be lawfully hated.
잠언-11-16.theologicalNote: 15. (Compare Pr 6:1 ). suretiship-- (Compare Margin), the actors put for the action, which may be lawfully hated.

잠언-11-17.title: 잠언 11장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-17.exegesis: 16. retaineth-- or literally, "lay hold of as a support." Honor is to a feeble woman thus as valuable as riches to men.
잠언-11-17.theologicalNote: 16. retaineth-- or literally, "lay hold of as a support." Honor is to a feeble woman thus as valuable as riches to men.

잠언-11-18.title: 잠언 11장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-18.exegesis: 17. merciful-- kind to others; opposed to cruel. Such benefit themselves by doing good to others (compare Pr 24:5 ), while the cruel injure themselves as well as others. flesh-- that is, his body, by penuriousness ( Col 2:23 ).
잠언-11-18.theologicalNote: 17. merciful-- kind to others; opposed to cruel. Such benefit themselves by doing good to others (compare Pr 24:5 ), while the cruel injure themselves as well as others. flesh-- that is, his body, by penuriousness ( Col 2:23 ).

잠언-11-19.title: 잠언 11장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-19.exegesis: 18. a deceitful work-- or, "wages," which fail to satisfy, or flee away ( Pr 10:2 ; 23:5 ). sure reward-- or, "gain," as from trading ( Ho 10:12 ; Ga 6:8 , 9 ).
잠언-11-19.theologicalNote: 18. a deceitful work-- or, "wages," which fail to satisfy, or flee away ( Pr 10:2 ; 23:5 ). sure reward-- or, "gain," as from trading ( Ho 10:12 ; Ga 6:8 , 9 ).

잠언-11-21.title: 잠언 11장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-21.exegesis: 20. (Compare Pr 11:5 ). froward-- as in Pr 2:15 , opposed to the simplicity and purity of the upright. in their way-- or, "conduct."
잠언-11-21.theologicalNote: 20. (Compare Pr 11:5 ). froward-- as in Pr 2:15 , opposed to the simplicity and purity of the upright. in their way-- or, "conduct."

잠언-11-22.title: 잠언 11장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-22.exegesis: 21. The combined power of the wicked cannot free them from just punishment, while the unaided children of the righteous find deliverance by reason of their pious relationship ( Psa 37:25 , 26 ).
잠언-11-22.theologicalNote: 21. The combined power of the wicked cannot free them from just punishment, while the unaided children of the righteous find deliverance by reason of their pious relationship ( Psa 37:25 , 26 ).

잠언-11-23.title: 잠언 11장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-23.exegesis: 22. Jewels were often suspended from the nose ( Ge 24:47 ; Is 3:21 ). Thus adorned, a hog disgusts less than a fair and indiscreet woman.
잠언-11-23.theologicalNote: 22. Jewels were often suspended from the nose ( Ge 24:47 ; Is 3:21 ). Thus adorned, a hog disgusts less than a fair and indiscreet woman.

잠언-11-24.title: 잠언 11장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-24.exegesis: 23. (Compare Pr 10:28 ). wrath-- is that of God.
잠언-11-24.theologicalNote: 23. (Compare Pr 10:28 ). wrath-- is that of God.

잠언-11-25.title: 잠언 11장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-11-25.exegesis: 24-31. The scope of the whole is a comment on Pr 11:23 . Thus liberality, by God's blessing, secures increase, while penuriousness, instead of expected gain, procures poverty.
잠언-11-25.theologicalNote: 24-31. The scope of the whole is a comment on Pr 11:23 . Thus liberality, by God's blessing, secures increase, while penuriousness, instead of expected gain, procures poverty.
